title: AI rendering of the 3D view
button: AI rendering (photoreal image of the view)
noCapture: No view captured. Close this window and frame the 3D view.
captureNote: Frame the 3D view before opening this window; the selection is hidden for the capture. Renderings are not saved in the project: download the ones to keep.
promptNote: Built from the project (uses, storeys, roofs, outdoor spaces, site); edit freely.
keyNote: The key stays on this computer and is never saved in the project.
paidOk: I understand each rendering is billed by the provider to my account.
needKey: Enter an API key for this provider.

providerHints.gemini: Recommended: very realistic images, keeps the massing well.
providerHints.stability: Strictest geometry (edge control, ControlNet-like); slightly less natural.
providerHints.openai: Very good image quality; may drift a little from the geometry.

errors.payment_required: No credit left with the provider
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests, try again shortly
